parties: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited (seller) | Jopp Holding GmbH, Germany (buyer)
headline: Lumax Auto Technologies divests entire 50% equity stake in JV subsidiary Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies to German partner Jopp Holding GmbH
sum: Lumax Auto Technologies has completed the sale of its entire 50% equity stake in joint-venture subsidiary Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies Private Limited to co-founder Jopp Holding GmbH (Germany). The transaction represents full exit from the 50:50 joint venture, with control passing wholly to the German partner.
detail: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited, listed on NSE, held a 50% equity stake in Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies Private Limited (LJAT), a 50:50 joint venture with Jopp Holding GmbH. On 29 June 2026, Lumax completed the sale of its entire equity interest to Jopp Holding, resulting in 100% ownership by the German partner. The transaction was disclosed to the NSE as a general corporate update on 30 June 2026. The consideration amount and final terms were not disclosed in the public filing.
